toc.title: Dissertatio philologica in historiam miraculosi transitus Israelitarum per Mare Rubrum

book: A single Latin philological dissertation (Dissertatio philologica, Bern 1679) on the miraculous crossing of the Israelites through the Red Sea, with a title page and dedication at the front and, at the back, two appendices, Corollaria respondentis and Impertinentia; the body text is one continuous argument with marginal notes and Hebrew quotations.
